caption:
When you go mountain biking in Costa Rica, you quickly learn that the elevation profiles here do not believe in switchbacks. Our mountain trails often follow the direct spine of the ridges, presenting grades that demand absolute respect and, occasionally, a willingness to dismount and push. I design and test every route to ensure we balance these intense, physical challenges with the sheer reward of reaching these high, mist-shrouded cloud forests. Every steep climb is a reminder that the most rewarding vistas are earned, not given.
